# Quiet Reader

> Local-first article translator and reader. Import a URL or Markdown, translate
> into a chosen language (default: browser language) with any OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint, and read with
> optional local SVG figure redraw. No cloud account, no telemetry.

## Start

- Install: `npm ci && npm start` (Node.js 22+)
- Preview without credentials: `npm run demo`
- Headless install check: `npm run verify`
- Health: `GET /api/health`; setup: `GET /api/setup`
- Data stays in `READER_DATA_DIR` (default `./data`)

## Constraints

- Single-user local service; binds 127.0.0.1, no authentication.
- Do not expose to a LAN or the internet.
- API keys come from environment variables only.
- Windows supports API-only mode; local `.cmd`/`.bat` agents are unsupported.
